text:
Mira: quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A. we need owners + hard gating checks for API adaptive batching, Console per-route cost breakdown, and Optimize suggestions UI. trying to avoid last-minute surprises for customers/docs.
Ana: owners recap: batching -> Jamal/Gus (eng-runtime), cost breakdown -> Lin/billing+console, suggestions UI -> Priya/optimize.
Gus: technical note on batching: decoder path needs a small KV-cache change. canary must validate p95 across a representative traffic slice.
Mira: can we get concrete canary windows? marketing and docs need dates.
Ana: propose: batching canary 2024-07-08 (72h), open beta 2024-08-05; console cost internal preview 2024-08-12, public roll 2024-08-26; Optimize UI canary 2024-07-15, review 2 weeks after.
Lin: on cost numbers: we'll surface an "estimate" label. customers asked for line-item accuracy; we will provide a CSV export of raw tagged usage alongside the estimate for reconciliation.
Priya: Optimize canary asks: we need +45 days eval-log retention for the canary cohort and a feedback widget in the UI. ops/security signed off on opt-in only.
Sam: docs ask: please attach a small token-profile.csv and a reproducible route archetype so we can build screenshots and a runnable sample.
Mira: Sam/Ella will pair with Gus to get sample data. who owns screenshots? marketing -> Kevin, docs -> Sam.
Gus: SDK flag name suggestion: `enable_adaptive_batching`. example snippet we'll publish: `client.configure({enable_adaptive_batching:true, batching:{max_latency_ms:20, min_batch:3}})`. we'll add an ordering caveat in the migration notes.
Lin: UI gating: feature-flag `per_route_cost_v1_preview`. backend tags must be stable for 48h before internal preview. also need copy for tooltip: I'll draft and circulate.
Priya: UX will show a subtle "beta" pill and a feedback link. we will capture click-throughs and freeform feedback for quality signals.
deploy-bot: scheduled: canary/batching on 2024-07-08 01:00 UTC. health checks: p95 latency, error-rate spike, KV-eviction-rate. rollback: auto if error-rate > 1.5x baseline.
deploy-bot: note: canary window 72h, metrics will be posted to eng-sre.
Mira: gating checklist proposed: (1) p95 regression <= 8% on sampled flows, (2) cache-hit delta <2%, (3) no customer-facing errors introduced, (4) docs + SDK examples published, (5) feature-flag controls for Dedicated migrations.
Ana: finance ask: show a side-by-side of estimated vs billed for one anonymized large org during internal preview. Raj/finance to send sample.
Gus: infra ask: Dedicated pinned-model orgs need a migration guard toggle. we'll surface a console toggle and block automatic migration unless org enables it.
Sam: docs-bot: docs ticket created: DOCS-3421. please attach sample route and token-profile.
Mira: action items: (A) Gus publish sample route + SDK snippet by 2024-06-20, (B) Sam/Kevin produce screenshots for internal preview by 2024-07-03, (C) Lin deliver tooltip copy by 2024-07-01, (D) Priya add feedback widget and retention opt-in by 2024-06-28, (E) infra/trevor open migration JIRA for Dedicated toggle by 2024-06-19.
Priya: will upload mockups to the canary ticket.
Lin: will schedule a billing sync with finance and eng by Monday.
Mira: will compile a short post-all-hands summary and link back to this thread. ping me if dates change. :thumbsup:
